title: Esther Aflalo
summary:
Esther Aflalo is a Belgian actor who voiced Hippolyta and Lady S. in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

She is notably the voice of Stella in the French dub of Iginio Straffi's other animated series, Winx Club.

'''Esther Aflalo''' is a Belgian actor who voiced [[Hippolyta]] and [[Lady S.]] in the French dub of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]''. 

She is notably the voice of Stella in the French dub of [[Iginio Straffi]]'s other animated series, ''[[w:c:Winx_Club_Wiki|Winx Club]]''.
